title: Configure a five-to-ten-player Solo simulation through controlled inputs
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/DESIGN_RECONCILIATION.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md and your frozen export contract in docs/PILOT100_UI_CONTRACTS.md before coding. Implement only your owned leaf module using installed React/TypeScript/testing dependencies. Export the exact named component and readonly props/types from index.tsx; keep module-local styles and tests inside that directory. Do not import an unmerged A/B task, edit App.tsx/shared barrels/manifests/task metadata or silently change another contract. This is controlled recipient-safe presentation, not an authority or complete application. Authority state/capabilities and semantic callbacks are supplied; no Firebase/native/store/network calls, secret caching, clock-driven game transitions, asset generation or fabricated success. Use original neutral-frost chrome, semantic HTML/keyboard access and honest unavailable media/provider states. Overlay leaves supply content to the separately composed modal host; do not claim global focus blocking in a content-only leaf. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, credentials, cloud deployment or budget changes. Preserve concise handoff, observed validation/failures and unknown costs under the benchmark policy. Render a 5–10 stepper, supplied bot-difficulty and duration options and one Start simulation action. Explain that fair bots use the same rules/information as humans. Authority availability controls start; Firebase is not a prerequisite for Solo. Own only apps/client/src/pilot100/solo-setup/; provide index.tsx exporting SoloSetup, SoloSetupProps and any named local types documented for B005. This task consumes part of A029; do not double-count it as a second implementation of that broad work. Run scoped React tests/lint/typecheck and node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; report actual results and unresolved application integration.
acceptance: The stepper refuses less than5 and more than10 without altering other controlled values.
Only supplied difficulty/duration IDs are emitted; no preset5/7/9 game modes are invented.
Unavailable authority keeps Start disabled with the supplied reason, without fake demo wins or a Firebase demand.
Exact frozen export/readonly props are implemented and scoped lint/typecheck/meaningful React tests plus node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full pass; only owned files change.
